name: Kotarou
source:
The pet dog of Nadeshiko. Despite her average intelligence, she is a highly respected police dog, due to her excellent pedigree resulting in high capabilities. 
She was extremely violent and aggressive when younger, seriously injuring Nadeshiko. Now that she is more mature, she regrets behaving like she did, and has a very good relationship with Nadeshiko.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wanko_to_Kurasō]Wikipedia[/url]]
